update TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T1 set T1.RELEASE_STATUS='0',T1.IS_MANUAL_RELEASE='' where T1.TRADE_ID= #{tradeid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID tradeId from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id = tpda.trade_id LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} and PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' and PS = 'T23' and TRADE_STATUS = '01' and IS_CANCEL = 'N'
select TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} and PS = 'T23' and TRADE_STATUS = '01'
